speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: Good evening, how are you?

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: I'm great. Hope you've had a good weekend.

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: You too. Where are you from?

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: I'm from New Hampshire but moved south 9 years ago. How about you?

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: Chicago. Where is south? How's the weather?

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: I'm near Savannah and Hilton Head. Hot and humid, lots of thunderstorms. But so much better than ice and snow and freezing cold!

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: Ha! Yeah. We have those storms now. It's pretty scary now. What do you do for a living.

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: I'm retired. Used to sell health insurance. Worked for an HMO, back in the days when health insurance wasn't such a dirty word.

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: Nice. Have you ever heard of save the children?

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: I think so but I'm not sure of the specifics. Are you involved with them?

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: Kind of...Save the Children is an international non-governmental organization that promotes children's rights, provides relief and helps support children in developing countries.

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: Yes. I care about those things. I did 3 mission trips to Africa working with children orphaned by AIDS and placed in foster homes by a Christian organization.

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: Wow! Would you like to donate a small part of your income payment to them today?

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: I think I'll pass. I donate to lots of other causes - my church, HIV issues and others.

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: I understand. There's a lot of great causes out there and you've chosen some great ones.

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: Thanks. So have you. You have a blessed day.

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: You too. Have you been on murk long?

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: Since last Thanksgiving. It's a small way to add a bit of extra money to the pot for travel. And you?

speaker: A3QN9B9ZS1CWWM
text: About a year now. I use it to pay for house upgrades...

speaker: A1ZUG1RU6O9FYF
text: Sounds like you're earning more than me....
